verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's GitHub repo says it is open source under AGPL-3.0 and available as a hosted service, so a developer can run the code themselves. But the cloud version 'includes additional features', so the self-hosted version has fewer capabilities. A community comment also notes the open-source builds lack a proxy service. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting/deployment instructions (e.g. Docker or setup guide), feature parity with the cloud version, hands-on reports of running it self-hosted.
